'''2008 New York State Championship Kirk England LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kirk England]] at [[2008 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Kirk Cyland
* '''Deck name:''' Light
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
